messages:
Priya: Quick request — can we run an onboarding bench for polaris-4b (polaris/v1) on the p4d pool? Need latency/throughput/regression vs aurora7b baseline. Target seq=8192, batch sizes 1,4,16. Capture p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, mem footprint + flamegraphs. Runs: fp16 (no quant) and q4_0. ETA EOD if possible.

Mateo: On it. KV cache enabled? Which tokenizer exactly (HF name)?

Priya: KV cache=true for all. Tokenizer=polaris/v1-bpe. Run both continuous-batching on/off. Include fp16 and q4_0.

Evan: I'll run cont-batch=off experiments + perf counters + nvprof traces. Want me to upload flamegraphs to artifacts?

Mateo: Yes. Upload to /artifacts/polaris-4b/2050004321/{run}/ and paste links. I'll start the baseline+quant matrix.

bench-bot: queued job b-2050004321-01 on pool p4d-2x. config: polaris-4b@v1, kv_cache=true, seq=8192, batch=[1,4,16], quant=[fp16,q4_0], cont_batch=[on,off]

Anika: FYI maintenance window on p4d-2x at 22:30 UTC. Jobs overlapping may be preempted. ETA EOD might be tight.

Priya: Add fallback to g5a pools if p4d gets preempted. Also please mark any retries in the artifacts.

Mateo: Job started, streaming logs now. (kickoff)

bench-bot: job b-2050004321-01: run 1/12 complete
bench-bot: job b-2050004321-01: run 6/12 complete
bench-bot: job b-2050004321-01: all runs complete, uploading results

Mateo: Raw CSV + flamegraphs uploaded: https://artifacts.internal/polaris-4b/2050004321/

Mateo: Summary (avg over 100 sequences each config):
- fp16, batch=1: p50=62ms, p95=95ms, p99=140ms, tokens/sec=210, mem=13.2GB
- q4_0, batch=1: p50=78ms, p95=160ms, p99=220ms, tokens/sec=170, mem=8.9GB
- fp16, batch=4: p50=240ms, p95=410ms, p99=600ms, tokens/sec=880, mem=13.9GB
- q4_0, batch=4: p50=310ms, p95=520ms, p99=820ms, tokens/sec=700, mem=9.2GB
- fp16, batch=16: p50=920ms, p95=1280ms, p99=1450ms, tokens/sec=2300, mem=15.7GB
Note: cont-batch on reduces p99 by ~15-25% for batch>1

Observation: q4_0 drops memory ~33% but increases tail latency (p99) on cold KV warmup. We observed a heavy dequant kernel on the first decode token causing a spike.

Evan: Flamegraphs: https://artifacts.internal/polaris-4b/2050004321/flamegraphs.zip
I see a hot path in attention/kernel + softmax_cuda; dequant codepath shows spikes at token 0. I'll add annotated SVGs and callouts.

Anika: One automatic retry on p4d-2x-17 at 2050004350 due to OOM during allocation. Bench-bot retried on g5a-4 and completed.

alice-sre: Confirmed single OOM, node recovered. Logged incident INC-2050004. Auto-retry succeeded, no wider impact.

Priya: Action items:
- Mateo: open perf PR summarizing these numbers, include artifact links and flamegraphs, propose pre-dequant for token 0 as an optimization
- Evan: attach annotated flamegraphs + nvprof snippets to the PR
- Anika/SRE: add a note about p4d maintenance fallback behavior to the runbook
- QA: add regression test comparing aurora7b baseline (p99 + tokens/sec)

Mateo: PR opened: https://repo.internal/pulls/4123 — includes CSVs, perf table, and suggested micropatches. Tagging @eng-runtime.

Evan: Uploaded annotated svgs and a short perf note `dequant-hotspot.md` in artifacts.

deploy-bot: heads-up — runtime-3.22 canary to p4d pools scheduled for 2050007200 UTC; may change kernel selection behavior (opt-in).

Priya: Can we gate runtime-3.22 on this model until the dequant regression is addressed? Prefer a small 10% canary rather than full rollout.

alice-sre: We'll gate canary to 10% and abort if p99 for polaris-4b degrades >10% vs baseline.

Mateo: Adding a CI micro-benchmark: 50-sample polaris-4b seq=2048 batch=1 q4_0 check failing on p99 regression.

Priya: Thanks all — filing onboarding doc and linking these artifacts. :thumbsup:

Evan: Small patch suggestion in PR to pre-dequant the first token on GPU to avoid syncs; will include perf numbers in PR.

Mateo: Closing thread once PR merges. Last artifacts: https://artifacts.internal/polaris-4b/2050004321/

Priya: thanks all :raised_hands:
